blocks.text: The gentle, half-deaf keeper of the Lantern Shrine in [[Port Vellen]]. Lights the harbor lamps every dusk, remembers everyone's name, and buries the drowned that nobody claims. The whole town owes him a favor and he has never once collected.

Aldous was a novice when the [[Undercrypt of Maro]] was sealed — he is the last living person who saw the inner door and the last to hold [[The Hollow Crown]]. He gave it to the sea from the shrine's pier. On a calm night he can point to the spot.
